text.content:
Marcus Vitel is the most powerful prince in the United States following the recent demise of Prince Lodin of Chicago, ruling Washington, D.C. as his personal fiefdom with a subtlety and patience unmatched among his peers. He has never called a Blood Hunt, preferring to let targets suffer unfulfilled anticipation as his ultimate weapon, and he deliberately downplays the true extent of his power — believing, correctly, that other Kindred's imaginations will always credit him with more strength than he displays outright. He rarely uses his Disciplines or walks the halls of Elysium directly, delegating instead to trusted agents like Gino Manitelli and @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.cities.JournalEntry.f96d005987e449a4]{Karina Dobson}, and quietly Blood Binds promising neonates by first letting his @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.6868ee8c357f4b73]{Sabbat} allies sabotage their fledgling operations, then "generously" overlooking their incompetence in exchange for a drink from his own vitae.

Few Kindred in Washington know Vitel's darkest secret: beneath his @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.OpCOs3PLjmtl0QVu]{Ventrue} mask, Marcus Vitel is secretly @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.phgt6OMwTAoAaKfR]{Lasombra}, and secretly allied with the @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.6868ee8c357f4b73]{Sabbat} — a truth that would upend the entire @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.fc464242d84d4e34]{Camarilla} power structure of the city if it ever came to light. Only a handful of the city's oldest Kindred, such as Dorian Adams, suspect the truth, and none dare speak of it openly for fear of the Prince's wrath. Vitel maintains close ties to a Sabbat agent named Sejanus through his contact Jack, calling on Sabbat support when it serves his ends and using anti-Sabbat paranoia to keep his own domain xenophobic and tightly controlled. He keeps two Blood Bound "daughters," Monica and Cynthia Black, as much for amusement and political theater as for any real affection.

Peter Dorfman is the @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.jaYCq9rVOh0I9NCN]{Tremere} Pontifex overseeing Mid-Atlantic and formerly broader United States politics, a position that in any other city would make him the undisputed prince — a fact that gnaws at him constantly in Washington, where Marcus Vitel retains the throne. A 7th-generation elder Embraced in 1700, Dorfman commands the Washington Chantry from the Octagon House, commands vast wealth through control of nearly a third of the city's political action committees, and carries numerous magical wards against Auspex, Dominate, and Presence at all times. He believes he should control everything, and has turned his frustration with Vitel and with Powell (the uncooperative Pontifex of the Western United States) into an obsession with amassing enough power to force the world to his will.

Dorfman strongly suspects Vitel has @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.6868ee8c357f4b73]{Sabbat} ties but refuses to act without absolute proof, and privately wars against the Technocracy's New World Order, having orchestrated a lethal strike on agents near CIA headquarters in Langley. His own Chantry is riddled with internal rivalries he is too consumed by grand strategy to fully police, chief among them the ambitions of @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.cities.JournalEntry.c9dbcaec9a92449b]{Regent Helena Taylor} and the rebellious poet Pieter Van Dorn.

Helena Taylor is among the most respected Kindred in Washington's Elysium, a leading harpy who quietly administers much of Elysium for the Prince, manages the @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.jaYCq9rVOh0I9NCN]{Tremere} Chantry's day-to-day affairs for Pontifex Dorfman, and maintains cordial relations even with the @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.UhaIbwzsC1O2x9vr]{Nosferatu}. She is a prominent Getlin Oil Company lobbyist by night, preys almost exclusively on senators and congressmen, and is owed boons by nearly every significant Kindred in the city. Some whisper she would make a better prince than either Vitel or Dorfman.

Helena's closest-guarded secret is her mortal past as a mage of the Order of Hermes; her former apprentice, Trevor Barron, has come to Washington seeking to reclaim her, and she fears what the @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.jaYCq9rVOh0I9NCN]{Tremere} would do to them both if the connection were ever discovered. She maintains a close, complicated bond with her rebellious childe Pieter Van Dorn, and a sisterly rivalry-alliance with Monica Black, the two having agreed to help unseat each other's overlords should the opportunity arise.

Colin Rose is the @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.jaYCq9rVOh0I9NCN]{Tremere} Chantry's most polished public face — a debonair pianist and socialite who could pass for a @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.GaCuLGcjZZjf2EO6]{Toreador} primogen, seen nightly in Elysium alongside notables like Angelique Stravinsky and Monica Black. Sired by Helena Taylor, Rose craves nothing more than center stage, supporting Dorfman and Regent Meerlinda only so long as they keep stroking his ego, and delighting in taunting his rival Pieter Van Dorn, whose relationship with Angelique Stravinsky he resents bitterly.

Born in apartheid-era South Africa, Pieter Van Dorn made his name as an exiled anti-apartheid poet before the @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.jaYCq9rVOh0I9NCN]{Tremere} Embraced him in Washington in 1975 — for reasons even he has never dared ask Helena Taylor, his sire and reluctant beloved. Convinced that the @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.fc464242d84d4e34]{Camarilla} is no better than the government that exiled him, Pieter has become the Chantry's tolerated "token liberal," maintaining quiet contacts with anarchs and Setites while serving as one of Art Morgan's trusted "Archons." He has fallen deeply in love with the @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.GaCuLGcjZZjf2EO6]{Toreador} Angelique Stravinsky, stolen from his rival Colin Rose, and Regent Taylor and Pontifex Dorfman both allow his rebellious streak to run its course as a useful source of intelligence on the city's malcontents — unaware, or unconcerned, that his convictions are entirely genuine.

A former Nazi occultist Embraced by the @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.jaYCq9rVOh0I9NCN]{Tremere} during World War II, Dr. Hans Schmidt is one of the clan's most useful and most expendable agents, traveling to Washington regularly to search the Library of Congress and National Archives for occult treasures and to report to Regent Meerlinda on the city's affairs. Unbeknownst to his clan, Schmidt secretly learned the forbidden practice of Dark Thaumaturgy from lost Essene texts on angelology and demonology recovered during the war, and now serves demonic patrons who promise him ever greater power should the Washington Chantry fall. An unrepentant Aryan supremacist who especially despises the @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.UhaIbwzsC1O2x9vr]{Nosferatu}, Schmidt leads a mortal cult called the Followers of the Body of God and hopes to corrupt Colin Rose and Pieter Van Dorn as his first steps toward the Chantry's ruin.

Dorian Adams gracefully ceded leadership of Clan @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.OpCOs3PLjmtl0QVu]{Ventrue} and withdrew from city politics the moment Marcus Vitel arrived, retiring to the fortified, gargoyle-crowned Castle Adams in the Maryland countryside. A 5th-generation elder Embraced in 1701, Adams affects the theatrical mannerisms of a cinematic vampire — sweeping capes, a hammy Romanian accent — as camouflage for genuine paranoia and genuine danger; his castle's secret corridors, security systems, and magical traps have swallowed entire @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.6868ee8c357f4b73]{Sabbat} war parties without a trace. Adams alone among Washington's elders has correctly deduced that Marcus Vitel is secretly @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.phgt6OMwTAoAaKfR]{Lasombra}, a secret he dares not voice for fear of being destroyed to protect it, and he has quietly begun cooperating with the Inconnu, who appear to him in daymares urging him to gather more proof against the Prince.

Dr. Edward Walker was a Civil War-era physician whose idealism curdled into bitterness amid the endless suffering of wartime Washington; the @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.OpCOs3PLjmtl0QVu]{Ventrue} elder David Case Embraced him hoping to use his medical connections, and though Case's bid to unseat Prince Marissa failed and cost him his unlife, Marissa chose to Blood Bind Walker rather than destroy him. Since Marissa's fall in 1968, Walker has built a quiet empire of influence across the D.C. area's retirement and nursing homes, which serve as ideal feeding grounds where deaths draw no scrutiny. Restricted by his own code to feeding only on the old and infirm, Walker has also cultivated a mutually beneficial relationship with the @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.z724BOvqpVyxjr6o]{Giovanni}.

Sent to Washington by New York crime bosses in the 1920s and Embraced by the @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.OpCOs3PLjmtl0QVu]{Ventrue} elder Mary Singer to help combat @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.z724BOvqpVyxjr6o]{Giovanni} incursions, Gino Manitelli was the first Kindred in the city to recognize Marcus Vitel as the rightful new Prince, delighting simply in having an Italian prince to serve. After his operations were repeatedly disrupted by @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.6868ee8c357f4b73]{Sabbat} interference and his own frenzies threatened the Masquerade, Vitel required Manitelli to renew his vows and become Blood Bound, and Gino has served with gangster-movie devotion ever since, running gun-smuggling operations, cultivating pawns throughout local law enforcement and the DEA, and keeping the hulking Blood Bound ghoul Guido as his enforcer.

A former Department of Defense investigator Embraced by Gino Manitelli, @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.cities.JournalEntry.f96d005987e449a4]{Karina Dobson} is Marcus Vitel's chief intelligence gatherer, expert in surveillance tradecraft from laser window-listening to database infiltration to erasing a person's identity with a signature. Her greatest coup was locating and Blood Binding an entire Delta Force team into ghouls, a private strike force capable of annihilating threats from rogue Garou to @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.6868ee8c357f4b73]{Sabbat} incursions. Fanatically loyal even beyond her Blood Bond, Karina keeps her considerable resources deliberately obscure — even her own sire found her only by accident — and the Prince purposefully limits contact between her and Manitelli to keep his intelligence network compartmentalized.

One of Prince Vitel's two Blood Bound "daughters," Monica Black plays the dutiful child in public while secretly hoping a rebellion will sweep her "father" away and leave her ruling a domain of her own — Rockville, Tyson's Corner, or Alexandria, perhaps. She despises her Blood sister Cynthia for both her stupidity and her refusal to ever defy Vitel, and maintains a close, mutually protective friendship with Helena Taylor, the two women having privately agreed to help unseat each other's masters should the chance arise. Unknown to Monica, Vitel genuinely favors her as his potential successor and future "queen," though he judges she still has much growing to do first.

The second of Prince Vitel's Blood Bound "daughters," Cynthia Black is secretly an operative of the @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.6868ee8c357f4b73]{Sabbat}'s Black Hand, convinced that hers will be the hand that finally stakes Marcus Vitel when his reign ends. She cultivates pawns like Pieter Van Dorn and Colin Rose against that day, believing the Prince can be blinded by flattery. Vitel, however, has long since seen through her, and tolerates her only because a known enemy agent is safer than an unknown one — he privately intends to have her destroyed three nights after she successfully recruits her first new Black Hand agent.

A gifted young musician Embraced by the @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.GaCuLGcjZZjf2EO6]{Toreador} elder Anne Hyatt to succeed her, Chas Voyager fled to Washington after the @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.6868ee8c357f4b73]{Sabbat} slew his sire and now leads the city's shattered, nearly extinguished @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.GaCuLGcjZZjf2EO6]{Toreador} remnant. Convinced Prince Vitel and Pontifex Dorfman are equally monstrous, Chas quietly schemes to weaken the @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.jaYCq9rVOh0I9NCN]{Tremere}'s political standing and eventually unite the @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.UhaIbwzsC1O2x9vr]{Nosferatu}, @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.zCWdD1NpOCn03CwE]{Gangrel}, and a reformed @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.jaYCq9rVOh0I9NCN]{Tremere} leadership against Vitel's rule. He suspects, uneasily, that visions of a beautiful muse guiding his art may mean he is an unwitting tool of the legendary elder Genevieve Orseau.

A former Bolshoi ballerina Embraced amid the chaos of the Russian Revolution, Angelique Stravinsky is one of Washington's most influential Elysium harpies and among the few @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.GaCuLGcjZZjf2EO6]{Toreador} to survive the clan's decimation under Prince Marissa and later Prince Vitel by consistently backing whoever held power. She is deeply, if improbably, in love with the @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.jaYCq9rVOh0I9NCN]{Tremere} rebel-poet Pieter Van Dorn (stolen from his rival Colin Rose), a relationship both clans quietly monitor, and she Embraced the mortal stage magician Wayland Smith on impulse to save his life, then erased his memory of the act rather than admit to violating the Traditions.

A former musical prodigy destroyed by D.C.'s drug culture, Rachel Evans was Embraced by Chas Voyager as she attempted suicide, and has since become treasured proof that even Marcus Vitel can be moved — harpy rumor holds she once brought the Prince to tears with a song. Tragically, a chance reunion with an old lover exposed her to an experimental Setite-engineered narcotic laced in his blood, reawakening cravings no drug on D.C.'s streets can satisfy; the @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.ssX4b2JFXF2uegC3]{Followers of Set} are now maneuvering through a ghoul intermediary to make her dependence permanent and turn her into a captive asset.

A stage magician and nightclub owner (the Black Magic, in Georgetown) Embraced on impulse by Angelique Stravinsky after an anarch attack left him dying, Wayland Smith hides a dangerous secret: a violent alternate personality named Rene, born the night he murdered three muggers as a mortal, which surfaces whenever he frenzies and remembers exactly who his true sire is despite Angelique's attempt to erase the memory. Many @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.GaCuLGcjZZjf2EO6]{Toreador} elders openly disdain him as an embarrassment to the clan, though his ghoul partner and longtime friend Raphael remains fiercely loyal.

A 6th-generation @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.ZFYurbvAHfaRguYI]{Brujah} Viking Embraced in 621 A.D. who fled Scandinavia's fall to the @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.OpCOs3PLjmtl0QVu]{Ventrue} and spent centuries in torpor before waking in colonial America, @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.cities.JournalEntry.069d13af9a21479d]{Bjorn Garinson} leads Washington's leaderless @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.ZFYurbvAHfaRguYI]{Brujah} more by default and inertia than active command from his club, Purgatory, in Adams-Morgan. He dreams of a united Brujah clan someday overthrowing the @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.fc464242d84d4e34]{Camarilla}, but his own clan's historical infighting has left him despairing of ever seeing it happen, and younger, more anarchistic Brujah increasingly look to Velvet for real leadership. Bjorn suspects — correctly — that Marcus Vitel may not be a true @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.OpCOs3PLjmtl0QVu]{Ventrue} at all, and keeps a battle-ax in Purgatory's back room with the Prince's name unofficially on it.

A former sex worker who survived a brutal, near-fatal assault only to be Embraced in desperation by her killer's remorseful attacker, Velvet quickly outgrew her sire Philip Freeman and has begun quietly organizing an anarch movement, convinced that Prince Vitel must fall if the city and its Kindred are to survive. Increasingly seen as the real leader of Washington's younger, more restless @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.ZFYurbvAHfaRguYI]{Brujah} in place of the aging @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.cities.JournalEntry.069d13af9a21479d]{Bjorn Garinson}, Velvet suspiciously received the Prince's blessing to Embrace a new childe (Emilio Gonzalez) — possibly because Vitel suspects her anarch sympathies and wants her indebted to him.

Radicalized by watching drugs and violence devastate his Southeast D.C. neighborhood and by his own sister's overdose death from pills he once sold, Philip Freeman was Embraced mid-firefight by an unknown sire after nearly killing a Setite in a berserk revenge rampage. Now a @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.ZFYurbvAHfaRguYI]{Brujah} vigilante armed with an AK-47 and a stolen flamethrower, Philip wages a one-man crusade against Northeast D.C.'s drug houses, his Humanity eroding with every body count, indifferent to the mounting likelihood that he will eventually torch the wrong building.

A small-time neighborhood drug dealer Embraced by Velvet after a violent, ego-wounding encounter, Emilio Gonzalez is a swaggering, resentful @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.ZFYurbvAHfaRguYI]{Brujah} neonate who blames Prince Vitel for every slight he's ever suffered and dreams of the day the clan recognizes him as a "real man." He has almost no genuine influence in the city, a fact he refuses to acknowledge.

A 7th-generation @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.zCWdD1NpOCn03CwE]{Gangrel} Embraced by Rhun of Tintagel around 550 A.D., Art Morgan is a beloved enigma in Washington — welcomed by anarchs, respected by the Garou (having visited the Sept of the Awakening), watched by Men in Black, and befriended by mages of both the Technocracy and the Traditions. Posing as a reporter for the tabloid magazine Deviant, Morgan has surrounded himself with a found family he calls his "Archons" (Tabitha Prester, Pieter Van Dorn, and Dr. Stephen Norton), a title he uses despite lacking any real Justicar authority; some @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.zCWdD1NpOCn03CwE]{Gangrel} even lobby for him to be named Justicar in truth. Beneath his mellow, spaced-out demeanor lies a deeply perceptive and possibly deranged elder whom almost everyone in the city consistently underestimates.

A minor occultist who built a pseudo-Egyptian cult of drugs, ritual scarring, and sacrifice in Washington, Joseph Fuller was accidentally Embraced by the wandering @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.zCWdD1NpOCn03CwE]{Gangrel} Adrienne Connor after a frenzy killed him during a private ritual; racked with guilt, Adrienne fled the city to avoid the Blood Hunt her sire-crime invited, leaving Joseph to be adopted uneasily into Clan @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.zCWdD1NpOCn03CwE]{Gangrel}. Secretly courted by the @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.ssX4b2JFXF2uegC3]{Followers of Set}, who offered him kinship he never found among the Gangrel, Joseph now fears exposure by Art Morgan or the Prince and dreams of founding his own bloodline by manipulating his own childe, Tabitha Prester — a plan complicated by Art Morgan's strong hold over her.

Embraced against her will by the unstable cultist Joseph Fuller, Tabitha Prester found sanctuary and mentorship instead with Art Morgan, who taught her the Traditions and made her one of his "Archons." A Blood Bound scholar of Kindred history with privileged access to Prince Vitel's ancient Latin library (the Prince enjoys conversing with her in his native tongue), Tabitha is quietly in love with Art Morgan, deeply protective of the childlike @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.UhaIbwzsC1O2x9vr]{Nosferatu}-adjacent @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.zCWdD1NpOCn03CwE]{Gangrel} Melissa (whom she mothers and shelters), and friendly with both Chas Voyager and @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.cities.JournalEntry.069d13af9a21479d]{Bjorn Garinson}.

Embraced as a young child around 1914 by an unknown sire who abandoned her immediately afterward, Melissa retains a seven-year-old's mind and manner across the decades, believing herself simply a little girl who loves her cats ("kitties") and wishes Art Morgan and Tabitha Prester would marry so she could finally have a family. Protected by Tabitha and tolerated fondly by Prince Vitel himself, Melissa's total lack of guile and childlike @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.zCWdD1NpOCn03CwE]{Gangrel} features make her one of the more unsettling and oddly sympathetic fixtures of Washington's Kindred community.

The reclusive, disability-affecting clan leader of Washington's Malkavians, @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.cities.JournalEntry.ba13b8b454604cf3]{Scott Levin} has held the position since the turn of the century despite most of his own clan being unaware he leads them at all. A 9th-generation elder who becomes startlingly lucid and dangerous only while working his six phone lines and array of online connections (including access to CIA message boards), Levin controls the city's computer networks, designs viruses, and exchanges nightly intelligence with fellow Malkavians Dr. Stephen Norton and Dr. Jeffrey Granger — a threat almost no one in Washington fully appreciates because he can barely hold a normal conversation in person.

Embraced in 1929 by @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.cities.JournalEntry.ba13b8b454604cf3]{Scott Levin} after her uncanny predictions of the stock market crash caught his attention, this @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.ZJx9H3XnU8yQGy9s]{Malkavian} has fractured into at least three major personalities following the guilt of unwittingly helping cause Prince Marissa's downfall: Cassie, an innocent child who befriends Melissa; Cassandra, a commanding primogen-level political operator who believes she is the true power behind Clan @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.ZJx9H3XnU8yQGy9s]{Malkavian}; and Olivia, a terrified 1920s mortal trapped in what she believes is a nightmare, who surfaces during Willpower failures and has attempted to kill "Cassandra." All three personalities share prophetic, Derangement-fueled visions of the future that much of Elysium takes far more seriously than they probably deserve.

A once-ordinary bureaucrat abducted, tortured, and Embraced by a sadistic @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.ZJx9H3XnU8yQGy9s]{Malkavian} named Rolf Trask, Gary Stapleton broke free of his sire's Dominate, murdered Trask with a razor blade, and reinvented himself as Razor, Washington's most notorious anarch agitator. Operating almost entirely through Obfuscate, ghoul intermediaries, and citywide graffiti campaigns, Razor claims credit for every anarch action in the city (whether or not he was involved) and specializes in psychologically brutal, rarely lethal attacks meant to jolt complacent Kindred out of their "gray zone" existence. Impersonators are common enough that even Kindred who meet him rarely trust their own certainty of his identity.

An 8th-generation @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.UhaIbwzsC1O2x9vr]{Nosferatu} who fled European vampiric politics and @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.6868ee8c357f4b73]{Sabbat} pursuit to a Washington too small to notice him in the city's earliest years, Nathan has spent three centuries watching and listening from the tunnels near the C&O Canal rather than acting. He alone among the @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.UhaIbwzsC1O2x9vr]{Nosferatu} has pieced together that Marcus Vitel was once @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.6868ee8c357f4b73]{Sabbat} and may not even be a true @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.OpCOs3PLjmtl0QVu]{Ventrue}, but his aversion to politics is stronger than his suspicion, and he refuses to move against the Prince or support Peter Dorfman's ambitions, confident that patience will outlast any of the city's current schemes.

A ragged, Obfuscate-masked @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.UhaIbwzsC1O2x9vr]{Nosferatu} who has appointed himself protector of Washington's homeless community, Amos rides the Metro constantly, gathering gossip and watching over the street people he considers his true responsibility. Nathan's childe, Amos maintains ghouls scattered among the homeless and occasionally operates Metro trains at Nathan's direction for the Prince's convenience, though his simple loyalty to Nathan is really rooted in getting to see "Princess" Cynthia Black, whom he adores from a respectful distance.

A recovering-alcoholic English teacher who relapsed once too often and was Embraced after collapsing in a closed Metro station, George Lawrence is Amos's childe and is quietly expected to become Clan @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.UhaIbwzsC1O2x9vr]{Nosferatu}'s next leader in Washington. He has built growing influence within the Metro transit system, allies with the Bone Gnawer Garou Blood Licker, and privately chafes at Nathan's refusal to move against the city's Setite infiltration.

A former serial killer who took a fateful Metro ride into a @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.UhaIbwzsC1O2x9vr]{Nosferatu} ambush, Glenn Courier was Embraced by George Lawrence specifically to redirect his violent impulses toward useful ends — namely, resolving vampiric "problems" with a chainsaw when subtlety fails. Courier still delights in scaring people and feeds by pulling grates out from beneath commuters' feet at Metro stations, though his sire keeps him reasonably contained.

A brilliant but socially invisible NIH biochemist who secretly moonlighted as an aspiring master jewel thief, Steve Norton was shot, then Embraced and abandoned mid-torpor by the sadistic @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.ZJx9H3XnU8yQGy9s]{Malkavian} detective Jasper Creed. He escaped, won Prince Vitel's grudging respect and protection, and joined Art Morgan's "Archons," continuing his thefts as a @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.ZJx9H3XnU8yQGy9s]{Malkavian} while investigating dangerous secrets — including his suspicion, and Vitel's fear, that he has learned too much about the Prince's "daughter" Monica Black. His one great vulnerability is Susan Williams, a mortal former NIH colleague he still loves.

College roommate and lifelong friend of Dr. Stephen Norton, Jeffrey Granger became a psychiatrist at the Bethesda Institute of Mental Health, treating (and occasionally psychologically breaking, on behalf of government handlers) an unusual clientele of ex-CIA agents and disgraced politicians. Accidentally Embraced when Norton frenzied during a Masquerade-threatening reunion, Granger now runs much of the Institute through a Dominated ghoul director, and his unusual empathic Derangement causes him to unconsciously mimic the worst traits and disorders of everyone he treats — a quirk that has earned him more enemies than friends among Washington's Kindred.

A internationally significant anarch hacker who deliberately avoids Washington's local anarch politics in favor of Movement-wide computer operations, Toby quietly runs errands for the reclusive @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.UhaIbwzsC1O2x9vr]{Nosferatu} elder Nathan, whom he considers genuinely powerful, while taking care to stay hidden from his rival @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.cities.JournalEntry.ba13b8b454604cf3]{Scott Levin}. His skills reportedly extend to breaching even the Arcanum's computer systems.

vtmlarp.source: DC by Night, Chapters Four & Five
